label: DEMO FIXTURE — NOT LIVE MODEL RESPONSE

contributing_factors.interpretation: Positive SHAP pushes predicted cancer_index_age_std up; adverse_direction marks pressure relative to the national median.

department_macro.action: Strengthen outreach and care-navigation for people aged 75+ living alone, including proactive symptom checks and social-care linkage into cancer pathways (strategy equality theme: older people; sub-objectives 3.3–3.4).
department_macro.responsible_actor: Wellbeing services county home care / older-people services; primary healthcare
department_macro.justification: Elevated 75+ living alone (45.4%) concentrates frailty and delayed help-seeking. Strategy emphasises functional-capacity–guided care and early psychosocial / social-work support for older adults.
department_macro.expected_impact: Earlier presentation among isolated older adults; fewer late-stage diagnoses in the 75+ cohort.
success_metrics: Time from symptom onset to first contact among 75+ living alone
Share of 75+ cancer patients with a named care coordinator
Stage I–II diagnosis rate in 75+ residents

department_macro.action: Scale RAI / functional-capacity assessment coverage for 75+ and introduce the G8 screening tool in all units treating older cancer patients, feeding results into primary-care referrals (strategy sub-objective 3.4).
department_macro.responsible_actor: Wellbeing services county geriatric and oncology services; City of Helsinki / HUS where applicable
department_macro.justification: Low 75+ RAI assessment coverage (17.3%) indicates incomplete geriatric assessment. Strategy 3.4 requires G8 screening, geriatric assessment for abnormal results, and functional-capacity data already in primary care.
department_macro.expected_impact: Treatment plans matched to frailty rather than chronological age; safer diagnostics and fewer avoidable complications in frail patients.
success_metrics: Share of older cancer patients screened with G8
Share of counties offering primary-care consult to a geriatric oncology team

department_macro.action: Deploy a targeted, multichannel cancer-symptom and screening awareness campaign for lower-education and linguistic-minority residents (strategy sub-objective 1.3 on health literacy).
department_macro.responsible_actor: Wellbeing services county communications & prevention; FICAN; Cancer Society of Finland
department_macro.justification: The county’s higher education share is relatively low (29.2%), which points to socioeconomic and health-literacy risk. Strategy 1.3 links limited literacy to delayed care-seeking and weaker screening participation.
department_macro.expected_impact: Fewer avoidable delays from symptom to first contact; narrower education-linked gaps in screening and outcomes.
success_metrics: Screening participation by education / mother-tongue stratum
Share of residents recognising key cancer alarm symptoms (survey)
Median patient delay from symptom onset to first contact

validated_sources: Finnish Cancer Registry (screening invitation / cancer index inputs)

evidence_classes.validated_thl_fcr: Observed county indicators and cancer_index_age_std from THL Sotkanet / Finnish Cancer Registry extracts.
evidence_classes.calibrated_projections: Model predictions, SHAP contributions, and (when present) Kuitunen-calibrated pathway day estimates.

confidence_and_limitations.data_year_basis: Latest available county year in training table / Sotkanet extract

distinction.validated_findings: County indicators and observed cancer_index_age_std come from validated THL Sotkanet / Finnish Cancer Registry inputs in the training extract. Treat these as the evidence baseline.
distinction.calibrated_projections: Predicted cancer_index_age_std and SHAP attributions are model outputs from the county feature profile, not observed outcomes.

limitations: GroupKFold CV R² can be weak; use predictions for relative prioritisation, not absolute risk labels.
SHAP explains the fitted model, not causal effects.
Patient pathway days are heuristic calibrations for triage support, not clinical orders.
National Cancer Strategy interventions are mapped from adverse SHAP families and require local validation.
